summary: 37-year-old woman canyoneering in Oak Creek Canyon fell ~20 ft in a remote area 2.5 miles up the canyon, suffering back, rib and elbow injuries; wheeled-litter evacuation down-trail to a waiting ambulance.
notes: Team called out 2:30 p.m.; first team reached patient ~4:45; packaged with pain meds and oxygen, down-trail evacuation completed in ~1 hr.
